description: Dub a video into targetLanguage: transcribes, translates, voices each line fitted to the original timing, and mixes it over the original audio (ducked by default, or muted); returns an MP4 plus target-language SRT/VTT/JSON (audioTrack:true adds an M4A). Price per target language: 5 credits per source minute (voiceTier basic) or 12 (standard), plus transcription 1/min and translation 2/min unless you reuse transcriptionJobId/subtitles and translationJobId/translatedSubtitles. Voices: get_catalog kind voices. Unsupported languages fail before charging. No voice cloning or lip sync.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

audioTrack.description: Also return the dubbed audio as M4A.

fileId.description: Id of a file already uploaded with upload {action:'start'}, upload {action:'start_multipart'}, upload {action:'inline'} or import_url. Pass this or the media URL.

keepOriginalAudio.description: 'duck' (default) keeps the original audio at -18 dB under the dubbed voice; 'mute' removes it.

maxCredits.description: Spending cap for this call in credits (1 credit = 1 cent). If the price is higher the call fails with 422 before charging.

mediaUrl.description: Public https link to the video or audio (direct file, chat attachment URL, Google Drive or Dropbox share link; YouTube is refused). Pass this or fileId.

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the input captions or speech (ISO 639-1, e.g. en). Omit to auto-detect.

targetLanguage.description: ISO 639-1: en, es, fr, zh, ja, ko, hi, ar, bn, pt, ru, ur, id, de, tr, it, vi.

transcriptionJobId.description: Reuses its cues and its stored media.

voice.description: Voice id from get_catalog {kind:'voices'} (listen to sampleUrl first). Omit for the default voice of the language and tier.

voiceTier.description: Defaults to the voice's tier, else basic.

name: dub

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...

title: Dub video into another language
